subject: Re: Kickoff: private instruction data for alignment (dp_instructions)
body:
Staffing and compute, as promised.

Hyun leads DP fine-tuning and owns the epsilon accounting. Yara takes the synthetic-instruction sampling and the DP histogram resampling stage. Linnea handles the labeling/annotation leg and the SFT data assembly. Amara owns the training infrastructure end to end — the DP fine-tuning jobs, the TRL-based PPO pipeline for the RLHF leg, and the serving of eval checkpoints. To be explicit for resource planning: Amara is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026, rising from 40% in May, since June is when the RLHF runs and handoff hardening land. I've confirmed with her and blocked it in the allocation sheet.

Compute: DP fine-tuning of the 13B fits on 64 titan-a100 GPUs with gradient accumulation; no Vulcan ask this half.

Daniela
